note: What a server sends when a point one side can take from the other changes. The header names no object: it carries zero.

revisions.note: A client ignores it unless it shows the capture point panel. A client keeps one record per point, making every point up to this one, and projects each from value and rate as time passes.

fields.name: value
fields.note: How far the point is taken, from -100 to 100: toward side 100 where positive, side 200 where negative. A client shows how full it is as the value without its sign.

fields.name: rate
fields.note: How fast value changes, in units a second.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Who holds the point: 100 or 200, or 300 where it is neutral.

fields.name: point
fields.note: Which point, 0 to 255.

fields.name: state
fields.note: Zero to label the point by its name; above zero to label it with that number as a multiplier.
